rules.license_scope: Bind terms to the exact source manifestation and record/media object. Portal-wide text does not override a more specific source contract, and a source-specific license is not generalized to unrelated datasets.
rules.coordinate_rule: Do not request, reconstruct, infer, publish, log, or export private/obscured exact coordinates. Public exact coordinates are not admitted to this Phase 1 package; retain only an approved generalized or withheld representation.
rules.identity_rule: Provider, dataset, record, specimen, collecting event, site, survey, fruiting episode, biological individual, and media are separate namespaces.
rules.admission_rule: Public accessibility or successful download does not by itself authorize canonical training admission.

candidate_scope.meaning: Puerto Rico place and Fungi taxon candidate filters; not a mushroom-only denominator

access.api_rate_contract: Official developer guidance states max 100 requests/minute and asks clients to target 60/minute or lower.
access.bulk_strategy: Prefer supported exports/datasets for substantial acquisition; do not treat the application API as an unbounded scraper.

candidate_scope.meaning: Puerto Rico + Fungi discovery scope; not a mushroom-phenology denominator

access.search: maximum page size 300; hard search-window limit 100000 for a query
access.bulk_download: authenticated asynchronous download required for exhaustive retrieval beyond the search limit

sources.identity_policy: A GBIF manifestation of an iNaturalist/MyCoPortal/provider record is not independent biological corroboration by default.

sources.role: collection discovery and provider-specific archive manifestation plane
sources.identity_policy: Portal collection identity and provider dataset identity remain separate from individual occurrence/specimen identity.

sources.scientific_scope: Preserved specimens are contextual/voucher evidence unless a record independently supports the forecast target.
Strong microfungal/plant-pathogen relevance does not imply mushroom-fruiting forecast eligibility.

sources.authority: New York Botanical Garden fungal collection (NY)
sources.freshness_rule: A current retrieval of the profile does not make a 2021 dataset snapshot current.
